title: Pricing Plans
subtitle: Choose the perfect plan for your needs
description: Unlimited access to image compression tools. No storage limits. No ads.

free.name: Free
features: Max file size: 10 MB per image

pro.name: Pro
features: Max file size: 30 MB per image

items.question: Can I change plans at any time?
items.answer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes take effect immediately.

items.question: Is there a free trial for Pro?
items.answer: We offer a 7-day free trial with full access to all Pro features.

items.question: Are my images stored on your servers?
items.answer: No, we process your images in real-time and automatically delete them after download.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex) through Stripe.

items.question: Does it include customer support?
items.answer: Free plan includes email support. Pro includes priority support.
